# Generated by mods/cm_maps/tools/port_from_cm.py - do not edit by hand.
# Lifted from Construction Manager dev, cm_map_mode_triggers.txt.
# Renamed cm_ -> bcm_ and nothing else; rebuild after a CM update.
#
# Only the blocks this mod's maps reach: bcm_pf_method_is_tax_base, bcm_pf_method_is_population, bcm_pf_roads_is_current, bcm_pf_roads_is_best_possible, bcm_pf_naval_is_current_presence, bcm_pf_naval_is_optimal_harbor, bcm_pf_river_data_is_current, bcm_pf_location_is_lake, bcm_location_has_road_or_river


# Root is country. Tax-base placement scoring (the default; option 2 is proximity, option 3 is
# population).
bcm_pf_method_is_tax_base = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { exists = var:bcm_placement_finder_method }
		var:bcm_placement_finder_method = 1
	}
}

# Root is country. Population placement scoring (method option 3): weights each reached location by
# its population where tax base weights it by bcm_location_raw_wealth.
bcm_pf_method_is_population = {
	exists = var:bcm_placement_finder_method
	var:bcm_placement_finder_method = 3
}

# Root is country. Current-roads placement scoring (roads option 1; option 2 Max Roads is the default, option 3 is Best Possible).
bcm_pf_roads_is_current = {
	exists = var:bcm_placement_finder_roads
	var:bcm_placement_finder_roads = 1
}

# Root is country. Best-possible land infrastructure placement scoring (roads option 3): assumes
# the best roads everywhere (as option 2, Max Roads) plus unlocked, not-yet-built land
# infrastructure buildings.
bcm_pf_roads_is_best_possible = {
	exists = var:bcm_placement_finder_roads
	var:bcm_placement_finder_roads = 3
}

# Root is country. Current naval presence in the sea legs (naval option 1; option 2 Max Presence is the default); options 2-3 assume max.
bcm_pf_naval_is_current_presence = {
	exists = var:bcm_placement_finder_naval
	var:bcm_placement_finder_naval = 1
}

# Root is country. Optimal harbor capacity in the port legs (naval option 3).
bcm_pf_naval_is_optimal_harbor = {
	exists = var:bcm_placement_finder_naval
	var:bcm_placement_finder_naval = 3
}

# No scope. True when a completed river-adjacency harvest at the current version is in the save,
# so the per-location bcm_pf_river_neighbors lists the path search reads can be trusted. The stamp
# is written only by the harvest's completion branch, so a save taken mid-harvest reads false.
bcm_pf_river_data_is_current = {
	has_global_variable = bcm_pf_river_stamp
	global_var:bcm_pf_river_stamp = bcm_pf_river_version_value
	NOT = { has_global_variable = bcm_pf_river_process }
}

# Root is location. The three is_lake = yes topographies: in_game/common/topography/00_default.txt:228-286
bcm_pf_location_is_lake = {
	OR = {
		topography = lakes
		topography = high_lakes
		topography = salt_pans
	}
}

# Root is location. True if this location has a road (any type - gravel/paved/modern/railroad
# all count equally, see bcm_pf_edge_road_reduction_value) or a river. The road-or-river
# vegetation-cancel rule's location-only proxy for bcm_location_proximity_modifier: a bare
# location has no path-search direction to check a specific edge against, so num_roads/has_river
# (both direction-agnostic) are used as-is, assuming any road or river on this location runs the
# right way. The placement finder does NOT use this trigger - bcm_pf_prime_land_location checks
# each specific edge instead, since it knows the real hop-by-hop direction of travel.
bcm_location_has_road_or_river = {
	OR = {
		num_roads >= 1
		has_river = yes
	}
}
